metadata.title: Loop Space Models and Integral Homology of Connected Quandles
metadata.abstract: We construct a marked integral delooping of a connected quandle's covering monoid, realizing its rack space as a homotopy fiber. For finite connected quandles at primes $p$ not dividing a point-stabilizer order, we determine the local $A_\infty$ type and the ordinary rack cohomology shuffle algebra over fields of characteristic $p$. We compute integral quandle homology in all positive degrees for finite connected regular cyclic Alexander quandles and the tetrahedral quandle. At such primes dividing the quandle order, rack-space homotopy groups have exponentially many cyclic direct summands of fixed $p$-power order in each sufficiently large degree.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: quandle 的同伦模型与积分同调
analysis.workSummary: 作者构造连通 quandle 覆盖幺半群的带标记整系数 delooping，使 rack 空间实现为同伦纤维；在素数 p 不整除点稳定子阶时，确定有限连通 quandle 的局部 A∞ 型及特征 p 的 rack 上同调 shuffle 代数，并计算若干正则循环 Alexander quandle 及四面体 quandle 全部正次数的积分同调。
techniques: rack 空间的同伦纤维模型
局部 A∞ 结构与 shuffle 代数
固定 p 幂循环直和项的同伦增长
analysis.breakthrough: 在同一模型中连接积分 delooping、局部代数及具体同调计算；适当 p 还整除 quandle 阶时，每个充分大次数的 rack 同伦群含指数多个固定 p 幂阶循环直和项。
analysis.limitations: 素数条件必须同时核对点稳定子阶与 quandle 阶，不能将增长结论推广所有素数；全次数积分计算也仅针对摘要列出的特定 quandle 类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
